question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"devastating". ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Devastating" **means causing great damage or destruction.(बड़ी क्षति या विनाश करना) • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence. • The word is an adjective and is used to describe the impact of something. • The grammatical structure of the sentence suggests that the blank needs to be filled with an adjective. Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Option 1, **"lengthening", **means making something longer and does not fit the context of the sentence. (किसी चीज़ को लंबा बनाना और वाक्य के संदर्भ में फिट नहीं होना) • Option 2, **"inspiring", **means filling someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something and does not fit the context of the sentence. (किसी को कुछ करने या महसूस करने की इच्छा या क्षमता से भरना और वाक्य के संदर्भ में फिट नहीं होना) • Option 4, **"harkening", **means listening attentively and does not fit the context of the sentence. (ध्यान से सुनना और वाक्य के संदर्भ में फिट ना होना।) 43:T893, The correct answer is **"numbed". **
